page: Microsoft Azure D128nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Dndv6 server family. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The instance is designed for network-intensive operations, though it does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and substantial local NVMe storage, the D128nds_v6 offers a dense resource profile for large-scale deployments. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on its high resource density, combining massive compute capacity with local storage to reduce the need for external storage overhead in data-heavy operations. Appropriate workloads include large databases, network-heavy applications, enterprise general-purpose workloads, and distributed data processing tasks.
